product.name: Scheduled Passenger Air Transportation
product.description: Air transportation for passengers on domestic and international flights operated under the EGYPTAIR designator code (MS), with ticketed travel between airports and scheduled stopping places.

product.name: Flight Booking and Ticketing
product.description: Online and assisted booking for one-way, round-trip, and multi-city itineraries, including fare selection, passenger details, reservations, and electronic ticket issuance.

product.name: Manage My Booking
product.description: Online booking-management service for reviewing itineraries, selecting seats and meals, changing certain booking details, and prepaying for excess baggage when available.

product.name: Baggage Services
product.description: Carriage and handling of checked and cabin baggage, including baggage identification, free allowance rules, excess baggage payment, delivery, and procedures for permitted special items and animals.

product.name: EgyptAir Plus
product.description: EGYPTAIR’s frequent-flyer program, providing member accounts for managing program participation and earning or using mileage-related benefits subject to program rules.

product.name: Flight Status and Timetable Information
product.description: Online information services for checking real-time flight status and viewing scheduled routes, departure times, arrival times, and available destinations.
